text: Generates a full app (frontend, backend, database, auth, integrations) from a natural-language description
quote: You describe what you want to build, and Lovable generates a working application that includes frontend, backend, database, authentication, and integrations, all backed by editable code.

text: Syncs project code to a GitHub/GitLab repo you own, keeping them in sync automatically
quote: Git sync connects a Lovable project to a repository you own on GitHub or GitLab, and keeps the two in sync automatically

text: Autonomous Build mode takes ownership of a task and implements changes end-to-end
quote: Build mode (previously Agent mode) is Lovable's autonomous execution mode, designed to implement changes directly in your project. When you give Lovable a task, it takes ownership of execution end to end.

text: Generates signup/login pages wired to the backend with row-level security when asked to add login
quote: Ask Lovable to add login, and it generates the signup and login pages, wires them to your backend, and protects user data with row level security.

text: Manage app user sign-in methods including email, phone, Google, Apple, Microsoft, and SAML SSO
quote: Manage your app's users and configure how they sign in: email, phone, Google, Apple, Microsoft, and SAML SSO, all part of the built-in backend (Cloud).

text: Provides a SQL editor for direct database access
quote: For direct database access, use the SQL editor at Cloud tab → SQL editor

text: Includes built-in Basic and Deep security scanners plus optional connectors for more coverage
quote: Lovable includes two built-in security scanners, Basic scan and Deep scan, plus optional connectors for additional coverage.

text: Can turn a published app into an MCP server usable by ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI assistants
quote: Turn a published Lovable app into an MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI assistants. Configure tools, sign-in, permissions, and access.

text: Supports working locally: clone repo, edit/commit in your own IDE, and push changes back
quote: Work locally in your IDE. Clone the repository, edit and commit locally, and push. Your changes sync back into Lovable.

text: Lets you download the full generated codebase directly from the project
quote: If you only need a copy of your code, you can download your code directly from Lovable: use the Download codebase section in Project settings → Git

text: Supports real-time collaborative building with invited teammates/designers/developers
quote: Lovable lets you build websites together. Invite your designer, developer, agency, or anyone else. Everyone sees changes as they happen.

text: Supports connecting a custom domain or subdomain to a published app
quote: A custom domain lets you use your own domain or subdomain for your Lovable project instead of the default xxx.lovable.app URL.

text: Remixing a project creates your own independent, freely editable copy
quote: Remixing creates your own independent copy that you can edit freely, on any plan.

text: GitHub export/sync enables backups, PR review, branch testing, and deploying outside Lovable
quote: you can export and sync your project to GitHub: back up your code, review changes in pull requests, work locally in your IDE, test features on branches, and deploy outside Lovable

text: Publishing deploys a snapshot of the project to a shareable live URL in two clicks
quote: Publishing turns your Lovable project into a live web app by deploying a snapshot to a URL you can share.

text: Built-in Cloud backend provides database, auth, storage, edge functions, and AI with no infra setup
quote: Lovable hosts your app and includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required.

text: Work continues asynchronously; you can send follow-ups or corrections at any time to steer it
quote: Lovable working on a request doesn't block you. Send a follow-up, a correction, or a new idea at any time to steer the work

text: Describing needed data in chat causes Lovable to create the corresponding tables and schema
quote: Describe the data your app needs in chat, and Lovable creates the tables and schema for you.

text: Multiple collaborators in a project can each work in their own separate draft copy
quote: When several people build in the same project, each of you can work in your own draft: a separate copy of the project with its own chat and preview.

text: Enterprise admins can schedule deep security scans to run automatically across all projects
quote: Workspace admins and owners on Enterprise plans can schedule deep security scans to run automatically across all projects.

text: Provides log and network activity inspection for debugging issues
quote: Inspect logs and network activity to identify problems
